text: For the leader; of David. For remembrance.
Graciously rescue me, God! [AA]Come quickly to help me, Lord! [AB]
Let those who seek my lifebe confused and put to shame. [AC]Let those who desire my ruinturn back in disgrace.
Let those who say "Aha!" [AD]turn back in their shame.
But may all who seek yourejoice and be glad in you,Those who long for your helpalways say, "God be glorified!" [AE]
I am miserable and poor.God, come to me quickly!You are my help and deliverer.Lord, do not delay!
